描述_EN: and applied with a narrow yellow ground figured ribbon. the main part of the embroidery is located on the back side of the sleeves. informal wear. pink silk satin ground embroidered with multi coloured floss silks in satin and pekin knot stitch. han chinese woman's coat. the butterflies which are embroidered in pekin knot stitch are also outlined with white twisted thread in couched work. neck, cuffs, hem and side slits are trimmed with decorative borders made of a narrow black satin bias-cut band, a wider black silk band embroidered in shades of blue and white in satin stitches, and gold threads in couched work and an applied blue ground ribbon. blue silk plain weave lining. slit at sides. front fastening coat (three black silk loop and knot buttons), long and wide sleeves, straight folded-back cuffs. the sleeve bands are of blue silk satin embroidered in coloured silk with flowers, vases etc. the main body is embroidered with large butterflies, bats and scattered design of flowers ( peonies, orchid, magnolia, prunus).
描述_ZN: 并以窄的黄底花纹丝带进行装饰。 刺绣的主要部分位于袖子的背面。 非正式的磨损。 粉色真丝缎面地，用缎面和佩金结缝制的多色绒线丝绣。 汉族妇女的外套。 蝴蝶是用皮金结绣的，也是用白捻线勾勒出的耦合工作。 颈部、袖口、下摆和侧缝都有装饰性的边框，由一条窄的黑缎斜切带，一条较宽的黑丝带，用缎线绣出蓝色和白色的色调，还有金线的耦合工作和一条应用的蓝地丝带组成。 蓝色丝绸平纹衬里。 两侧开衩。 前扣大衣（三个黑丝圈和结扣），长而宽的袖子，直折袖口。 袖带是蓝色丝缎的，用彩色丝线绣有花朵、花瓶等。 主体绣有大蝴蝶、蝙蝠和散落的花朵图案（牡丹、兰花、玉兰、梅花）。
